newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads widen.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end firmer, Bund spreads widen.

text.p: 1703 GMT - Portuguese bond futures and cash ended firmer, with 10-year bonds widening yield spreads slightly against Bunds as the market focused on a three-day meeting of Group of Seven (G7) leaders in Denver. *Sept 97 futures up 0.14 points to 109.86 *Feb 07 cash (OTC) 101.78 (101.65), yld 6.37 (6.38) *Spread vs 10-yr cash Bund 65 bps vs 61 bps

Portuguese bonds ended firmer as yield spreads against 10-year Bunds widened slightly with attention focused on the Group of Seven leaders' meeting in Denver and the forthcoming FOMC meeting, dealers said.
"September futures and cash bonds closed stronger, reflecting the trend in Europe, but the yield spread against 10-year Bunds increased slightly," one dealer said.

Another said: "We will be keeping an eye on the G7, concerns over the French economy and the proximity of the FOMC meeting (on July 1-2), and so spreads against Bunds (next Monday) should not drop below 60 basis points."
